correctness.rationale: From rung adjacency z≤m and w=2m-z+e. The empty-layer alternation and twisted seam force the parity cases. Rainbow constraints at interior zeros force a unique 3-period color word. For even m only the one no-empty rung profile remains, with two uniquely forced endpoint singleton colors. For odd m=5 mod6, the alternative no-empty rung profile is contradictory because two endpoint empty vertices share one neighbor yet demand different colors; hence the unique extra color is a two-color label in a specified rung. Every case is exhaustively counted, m≥3 boundary included. Independent exhaustive checker agrees at m=3,4,5,6,8,9,10, and one-defect word census at m=11, but the infinite proof is combinatorial and does not depend on those experiments.

value.rationale: Exact degeneracy and classification of all resource-minimizing rainbow placements is a natural structural graph invariant beyond an already known numerical optimum. The constant-versus-linear count in a cubic twisted ladder is explained through topology-dependent one-rung or one-color defects; every optimum is explicitly constructed and counted for five natural congruence classes. The difficult sixth congruence class remains openly excluded, not disguised as a complete six-class theorem.
